name: Trirealm Rift Blaze
effectText: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) 4 cards from the top of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Trirealm Rift Blaze" once per turn. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 of your face-down banished Level 5 or higher "Trirealm Rift" monsters, also you cannot activate non-"Trirealm Rift" cards or effects for the rest of this turn.
